node.statement: Assume sigma_g<1 and define q=(p_v-sum_{j in G} a_j^+ p_j)/(1-sigma_g). Since p_v=sum_{j in G} a_j^+p_j+(1-sigma_g)q, the coefficients a_j^+ on G are nonnegative and have sum sigma_g<1, and H_j<=H=dist_1(p_v,C) for j in G, lem-residual-lower gives H<=dist_1(q,C); multiplying by 1-sigma_g gives H*(1-sigma_g)<= (1-sigma_g)*dist_1(q,C).
